name: murdoku-save-bank
author: YavaDeus
description: Browser extension to save named Murdoku grid states and restore them into the game's native save

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../murdoku-save-bank.zip . && cd .. && echo 'wrote murdoku-save-bank.zip ('$(du -h murdoku-save-bank.zip | cut -f1)')'
